name: io.github.DHEBP/dero-mcp-server
title: DERO MCP Server
description: Read-only MCP server for the DERO privacy blockchain. 21 daemon-read primitives + 7 composite tools (intent-shaped flows). Bundled DERO docs index, structured _meta.error codes, curated docs citations on every response.

tools.name: dero_daemon_ping
tools.description: Daemon liveness check.

tools.name: dero_daemon_echo
tools.description: Echo a list of strings — round-trip test.

tools.name: dero_get_info
tools.description: Daemon info: network, version, topoheight, stableheight, peers.

tools.name: dero_get_height
tools.description: Current chain height.

tools.name: dero_get_block_count
tools.description: Total block count.

tools.name: dero_get_last_block_header
tools.description: Latest block header.

tools.name: dero_get_block
tools.description: Block by hash OR height.

tools.name: dero_get_block_header_by_topo_height
tools.description: Block header by topological height.

tools.name: dero_get_block_header_by_hash
tools.description: Block header by hash.

tools.name: dero_get_tx_pool
tools.description: Current mempool snapshot.

tools.name: dero_get_random_address
tools.description: A random recent address; optional scid for an asset.

tools.name: dero_get_transaction
tools.description: Transaction by hash list; optional decode_as_json.

tools.name: dero_get_encrypted_balance
tools.description: Encrypted balance for an address at a given topoheight.

tools.name: dero_get_sc
tools.description: Smart contract state (code + variables) by SCID.

tools.name: dero_get_gas_estimate
tools.description: Gas estimate for transfers or SC deploy.

tools.name: dero_name_to_address
tools.description: Resolve a registered name to a DERO address.

tools.name: dero_get_block_template
tools.description: Block template for a mining wallet address.

tools.name: dero_decode_proof_string
tools.description: Decode a bech32 DERO proof/address string.

tools.name: dero_docs_search
tools.description: Full-text search across DERO docs (derod, tela, hologram, deropay).

tools.name: dero_docs_get_page
tools.description: Fetch a doc page by slug.

tools.name: dero_docs_list
tools.description: Enumerate doc pages, optionally filtered by product.

tools.name: diagnose_chain_health
tools.description: Composite: chain health narrative + signals + tip metadata + citations.

tools.name: explain_smart_contract
tools.description: Composite: contract kind classification + surface + curated DVM docs.

tools.name: recommend_docs_path
tools.description: Composite: natural-language intent → ranked doc page recommendations.

tools.name: estimate_deploy_cost
tools.description: Composite: deploy gas estimate + breakdown + parsed function surface.

tools.name: trace_transaction_with_context
tools.description: Composite: tx confirmation + kind classification + SC install surface.

tools.name: audit_chain_artifact_claim
tools.description: Composite: verify a chain-related claim end-to-end.

tools.name: dero_forge_demo_proof
tools.description: Composite: generate demo proof strings for testing.

resources.name: Server info
resources.description: Server metadata, tool list, resource list, prompt names.

resources.name: Safety boundary
resources.description: Read-only posture, excluded methods, write-path guidance.

resources.name: Composite catalog
resources.description: Full catalog of composite tools with intents, inputs, outputs, error codes.

prompts.name: network_health_check
prompts.description: Composite-first daemon sync and health check.

prompts.name: find_dero_docs_for_intent
prompts.description: Composite-first docs routing from natural-language intent.

prompts.name: estimate_deploy_for_contract
prompts.description: Composite-first DVM deploy pre-flight (gas + breakdown + surface).
